blocks.text: Software project ke kharche (cost) ka andaza lagana project planning aur management ka bohat aham qadam hai. Is mein project ko kamyabi se mukammal karne ke kul kharchon ki peshgoi (prediction) ki jati hai. Durust andaze se budget banane, wasail (resources) baantne aur haqeeqat ke mutabiq tawaqqo rakhne mein madad milti hai. Yahan hum kharche ke andaze ke aham factors dekhenge aur ek misal se process samjhenge.
Kharche ke andaze ke aham factors (Key Factors in Cost Estimation)

items: Development Team: kharcha developers ki tadaad, un ki maharat (expertise) aur fi ghanta ujrat (hourly rate) par depend karta hai. Khaas maharat wali teams zyada rate le sakti hain.
Technology Stack: chuni gayi technology, programming languages aur tools kharche par asar dalte hain. Kuch technologies ko zyada wasail ya khaas ilm chahiye hota hai.
Project Duration (muddat): lambe projects aam taur par mehnge hote hain, kyun ke wasail zyada der lage rehte hain aur scope (daira) badalne ka imkaan hota hai.
Risk Management: mumkina khatre (risks) pehchanna aur un ko kam karne ke plans banana kul kharcha barha sakta hai. Achanak masloon ke liye aksar contingency fund (hangami raqam) rakha jata hai.
Quality Assurance: testing, bugs theek karne aur software ko quality standards par lane ke kharche bhi andaze mein shamil hote hain.

blocks.text: Misal: farz karein Pakistan ki ek company online shopping ke liye mobile application banana chahti hai.

items: Scope: app mein user registration, product listings, shopping cart, payment integration aur order tracking honge.
Development Team: 1 project manager, 2 frontend developers, 2 backend developers, 1 UI/UX designer aur 2 QA testers.
Technology Stack: cross-platform (Android aur iOS dono) ke liye React Native, backend ke liye Node.js aur database ke liye MongoDB.
Operational Costs: cloud hosting, development tools aur software licenses ke kharche.
Risk Management: scope ki tabdeeli aur technology jorne (integration) ke masle mumkina risks hain; kul kharche ka 10% contingency fund rakha jayega.
Quality Assurance: functionality aur performance yaqeeni banane ke liye mukammal testing phases.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab QA Testers wali line mein testers ki tadaad (2) likhna bhool gayi hai: 2 x 2,500 x 20 x 24 = PKR 2,400,000. Kitab contingency fund PKR 1,604,000 aur Total Estimated Cost PKR 19,644,000 chhapti hai (Explanation mein bhi). Sahi hisab: chhe mad ka jama PKR 18,040,000 hai, us ka 10% PKR 1,804,000 banta hai, aur total PKR 18,040,000 + 1,804,000 = PKR 19,844,000. Kitab ne 10% ghalat nikala, is liye total bhi ghalat aaya.

Wazahat (Explanation): kul andazan kharcha PKR 19,844,000 development ke tamam hisson ko shamil karta hai: planning aur design se le kar implementation aur testing tak. Yeh misal dikhati hai ke mukhtalif factors kul kharche mein kaise hissa dalte hain aur kharche ke andaze mein tafseeli planning kitni zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Software development project shuru karne ke liye programming aana zaroori nahi! Aap apna idea freelancing platforms par daal sakte hain jahan developers aap ke project par boli (bid) lagate hain. Ghar walon ki madad se aap investors (paisa lagane wale) bhi dhoond sakte hain jo aap ke idea ke liye paisa dein. Is tarah professional madad se aap apne naye ideas ko haqeeqat bana sakte hain!

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa factor software project ke kharche ke andaze par asar NAHI dalta? (Exercise MCQ 8) Contingency fund ka maqsad kya hai? (Exercise MCQ 9)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 8: meetings ki tadaad (Number of meetings held), option (c). MCQ 9: achanak (unexpected) kharche poore karna, option (a), jaise scope ki tabdeeli ya integration ke masle. Kitab ki answer key MCQ 9 ke liye (c) deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khata.

items: Cost estimation: project ke kul kharchon ki peshgoi; factors: team, technology stack, muddat, risk management (contingency), quality assurance.
Misal ka sahi hisab: jama PKR 18,040,000; 10% contingency 1,804,000; total 19,844,000 (kitab mein 1,604,000 aur 19,644,000 chhapa hai).
